llm_response:
Here is the corrected and professionally formatted version of your email:

***

**Subject:** RFQ - ATR72-600 Work-Package Quotation

Dear All,

We are pleased to inform you that *Tunisair Express* has opted to launch this direct Quotation document (RFQ) to select an approved MRO to perform the work-package for its ATR72-600 aircraft.

Tenders must be prepared and presented in accordance with the international RFQ guidelines provided in the attached file. Tender offers must be sent either by email or by registered mail/express courier. 

Please note the following submission requirements:

**1. Email Submission**  
If you choose to send your offer (including all requested documents) by email, please send it to: [EMAIL ADDRESS]. 
*Please be aware that you must not include any other email addresses in the "CC" or "BCC" fields.*

**2. Physical Mail Submission**  
If you choose to send your offer via registered mail or express courier (rapid post), the offer must be placed in a sealed, anonymous outer envelope. The envelope must indicate the address of Tunisair Express and prominently display the following notation: 
**"DO NOT OPEN, A/C ATR72-600 Consultation"**

The sealed offer should be sent via rapid post to the following address:

> *Tunisair Express*  
> Attention: Monsieur le Directeur Général  
> Immeuble MAGREBIA TOUR A, 9 rue de l'artisanat  
> Z.I la Charguia II - 2035 Tunis Carthage  
> Tunisia

The closing date for the receipt of offers is fixed for **October 12th, 2023, at midnight**. The tender validity period shall be 120 days from the closing date. Please note that the bid opening session will not be public.

Salutations,

**[Your Name/Title]**  
Tunisair Express  

***

### **Key Corrections Made:**
*   **Spacing & Typos:** Fixed missing spaces (e.g., *lignesintérieuresetinternationales*, *viaconsultation*, *youchoose*, *sendyouroffer*). 
*   **Formatting:** Added bolding, bullet points, and spacing to make the instructions much easier to read.
*   **Grammar & Phrasing:** Corrected awkward phrasing (e.g., changed "be aware that do not include" to "you must not include," and changed "work-package of its Aircraft" to "work-package for its aircraft").
*   **Punctuation & Capitalization:** Standardized the capitalization (e.g., changed "Dear ALL" to "Dear All"). Corrected the placement of quotation marks and commas.
*   **Consistency:** Cleaned up the French mailing address to match standard international formatting while preserving the exact company name and location details.
